EU ETS

EU Emissions Trading System

The EU Emissions Trading System is the EU's carbon market. It covers power stations, industry, flights within Europe and, since 2024, shipping. Shipping now surrenders for 100% of its emissions. A second market, ETS2, for fuel used in buildings and road transport, starts in 2028.

Draft guide. We're checking this page against official sources before launch. Always confirm with your regulator.

Step 1

Are you in scope?

You're probably in if…

  • You run an installation in the EU/EEA with combustion above 20 MW or another listed industrial activity
  • You operate flights within the EEA, or from the EEA to Switzerland or the UK
  • You operate ships of 5,000 GT or more carrying cargo or passengers to or from EU/EEA ports: 100% of voyages within the EU and at berth, 50% of voyages into or out of the EU
  • Northern Ireland electricity generators remain in the EU ETS under the Windsor Framework

You're probably out if…

  • General cargo and offshore ships of 400–5,000 GT report under EU MRV from 2025 but don't surrender allowances. Whether they join the ETS is part of the 2026 review
  • ETS2 obligations fall on fuel suppliers, not on households or small businesses directly

Who regulates it: The national competent authority in each EU/EEA country. Shipping companies and aircraft operators are each assigned one administering member state.

Step 2

Your yearly routine

  1. All yearMonitor emissions under your approved monitoring plan
  2. 31 MarSubmit your verified emissions report (shipping: company-level data)
  3. 30 SepSurrender allowances for last year's emissions

Key facts

Penalty for not surrendering
€100 per tonne (index-linked), and you must still surrender
Shipping phase-in
40% of 2024 emissions, 70% of 2025, 100% from 2026
Shipping gases
Methane and nitrous oxide are included from 2026
ETS2
Delayed one year to 2028; politically contested
Practical tip

The EU surrender date moved from 30 April to 30 September in 2024. If you are also in the UK ETS, don't let the two surrender dates blur together.
